##   waitingSince  = later of (last customer message, moment an agent connected)
##   awaitingReply = an agent is connected AND no agent message at/after waitingSince
## Receipts / events never count as messages. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC with the
## same format, so string comparison (compareTo) orders them correctly.

  "anyAgentConnected": $anyAgentConnected,
  "customerConnected": $customerConnected,
  "awaitingReply": $awaitingReply,
  "waitingSince": "$waitingSince",
  "lastInboundTime": "$lastInbound",
  "lastOutboundTime": "$lastOutbound",
  "agentConnectedTime": "$agentConnectedTime",
  "agentStates": "$agentStates",
  "agentNames": "$esc.jsonString($agentNames)",
  "customerName": "$esc.jsonString($customerName)",
  "customerParticipantId": "$customerParticipantId",
  "channel": "$channel",
  "inboundMessageCount": $inboundCount
}

CONVERSATION_ID.description: Conversation id of the message interaction

anyAgentConnected.description: True while any agent participant is connected

awaitingReply.description: True when the customer is waiting on an agent reply

waitingSince.description: ISO-8601 UTC; later of last customer message and agent connect time ('' if none)

agentNames.description: Display names of the connected agent(s), '; ' separated

channel.description: webmessaging, sms, whatsapp, facebook, instagram, line, open, apple ...

inboundMessageCount.description: Customer message entries seen across participants (informational, may double count)
